name: Fear is the Mindkiller
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 4, bard 5, bloodrager 4, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, occultist 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous or 1 round; see text
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the target’s mind with such intense fear that it shuts down completely. This spell functions as feeblemind except as noted above, and if the target succeeds on their saving throw, they are shaken for 1 round.
